Removed huggingface_hub APIs

Missing Python dependency
Add the missing package to requirements.txt or remove the broken import.
Library API import mismatch
Update the affected library or replace the removed/renamed import with its current API.
Gradio API/version mismatch
Update Gradio calls to the installed version's API, replacing removed inputs/outputs, style(), queue concurrency, and launch arguments.
CUDA unavailable on CPU/non-GPU runtime
Use CPU execution or select GPU hardware; remove hard-coded CUDA device assumptions.
Removed NumPy aliases
Replace removed NumPy aliases with builtins or explicit NumPy dtypes and ensure NumPy is installed/importable.
PyTorch/torchvision/torchaudio version mismatch
Align torch, torchvision, torchaudio, and dependent packages to compatible versions or update deprecated calls.
bitsandbytes CUDA setup failure
Install a bitsandbytes build matching the CUDA/torch environment or disable quantization on CPU.
Missing system shared library
Install required system libraries in packages.txt/Dockerfile or use a CPU-compatible dependency.
Invalid or missing model/repository identifier
Correct the model or repository ID/path and required files in the code.
Gated or unauthorized repository access
Grant repository access and configure a valid Hugging Face token with the required permissions.
Network timeout or connection failure
Retry the build/run or check network/proxy settings; no code change can fix transient connectivity failures.
hf_transfer download failure
Disable hf_transfer or use the standard HTTP downloader in the environment/code.
Container runtime infrastructure failure
Restart or rebuild the Space; this is a platform/container runtime issue.
Scheduler or hardware capacity unavailable
Retry when hardware is available or request/upgrade the required hardware.
Launch timeout or unhealthy workload
Reduce startup time or memory use and restart the Space; platform health check timed out.
Memory limit exceeded
Use a larger hardware tier or reduce model/batch memory usage.
Storage quota exceeded or evicted
Free cache/storage or use a tier with more disk; platform storage quota was exceeded.
Missing weights or checkpoint file
Download or bundle the required checkpoint/weight files before loading the model.
Incomplete or corrupt download
Retry the download or clear the cache; the downloaded artifact was incomplete/corrupt.
Git clone or repository access failure
Fix repository credentials/access or remove the broken clone step.
Gradio localhost share link issue
Launch with share=True or configure proxy/localhost access for Gradio.
ZeroGPU quota or scheduling failure
Retry within quota or reduce requested GPU duration; ZeroGPU scheduling/quota failed.
ZeroGPU initialization or import order
Import spaces before initializing CUDA/PyTorch and use ZeroGPU-compatible APIs.
Permission denied or unwritable path
Use writable paths/cache directories and fix file permissions.
Build failure (unspecified or dependency build)
Fix build dependencies or Dockerfile/package installation and rebuild.
Dead external service or API error
Retry or migrate to a working service/API; the external dependency failed.
Pydantic version mismatch
Pin pydantic to the version expected by the app and update validators.
Altair version mismatch
Pin altair to a version providing vegalite.v4 or update Streamlit code.
ONNX runtime failure
Install a working onnxruntime build and ensure model files are present.
PyTorch weights_only unpickling failure
Load trusted checkpoints with weights_only=False or add the required classes via torch.serialization.add_safe_globals.
Hugging Face Hub download or cache failure
Retry after network recovery or pre-cache required files; these are connectivity/cache availability failures.
Hugging Face Hub API version mismatch
Replace deprecated use_auth_token arguments with token= or remove them for the installed huggingface_hub version.
Missing optional backend library
Install the missing backend dependency, such as torch, torchvision, detectron2, or flash-attn.
CUDA driver or GPU runtime unavailable
Use a GPU-enabled runtime or compatible PyTorch/CUDA versions; code cannot repair missing or incompatible GPU drivers.
CUDA runtime or out-of-memory failure
Reduce batch size/model size or use a larger GPU; these are runtime capacity/GPU errors.
ZeroGPU worker or infrastructure failure
Adjust ZeroGPU usage/quota or run on a non-ZeroGPU GPU runtime; host-cgroup and quota failures are infrastructure-side.
FlashAttention or Triton unavailable
Install compatible FlashAttention/Triton/CUDA tooling or disable FlashAttention in model loading.
Keras version incompatibility
Install tf-keras/legacy Keras or update model loading code for Keras 3.
Pillow version incompatibility
Replace removed Pillow constants with Resampling enums and validate image inputs before opening.
httpx/httpcore version incompatibility
Align httpx and httpcore versions so their constructor signatures match.
Gradio external Space or model loading failure
Fix the referenced Space/model identifier or provide a valid Hugging Face token.
Missing or corrupt model weights
Re-download or repair the checkpoint file; corrupt/partial weights cannot be fixed in code.
Environment variable or system configuration error
Set OMP_NUM_THREADS to a valid integer in the Space configuration.
